title: When the Spire Wakes
author: U. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Ada Nakamura, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
